use_case_summary: Target: regulated control-room assistants and automated incident summarization across classified logs. Primary workloads: low-latency chat for operator assistance (avg session 20-80 tokens/sec), embedding-based doc-search for SOP retrieval, and reranking of sensor alerts. Throughput targets: sustained 200 qps for embeddings jobs, bursty chat traffic with 95th percentile token latency <= 120ms on in-region on-prem hardware. Cost sensitivity secondary to compliance; prefer optimized quantized models where quality acceptable. Model preference: open-weight LLaMA-family variants with validated quantization to int8/4, fallback to smaller tuned variants for low-cost non-critical routes. Routing: strict on-prem routing, no cloud egress allowed; optional replication to an air-gapped analytics enclave nightly.
